title: National Compensation Survey
source_verification_depth: Complete Supporting Statement A plus package; underlying cited sources not all independently retrieved. Specific corroboration recorded separately.

score_rationale.reproducibility: Year, sector, contact type, response frequency and minutes are tabulated; averages use rounded annual totals.
score_rationale.provenance: March 2023 ECEC and historical collection experience identified; citation filename and underlying timing studies require verification.
score_rationale.segmentation: Initiation, update, nonresponse, testing and quality recontacts are distinct, with public/private strata.
score_rationale.labor: Direct ECEC compensation avoids a second benefits load; historical 70/30 occupational mix disclosed.
score_rationale.item13: Explicitly excludes capital, O&M and purchased services because only respondent time is used.
score_rationale.item14: Only collection/noncollection budget split, without workload or allocation derivation.
score_rationale.item15: Prior approval and new total identified; increased sample explains direction but no quantitative driver bridge.
score_rationale.validation: Past collection experience supports timing and mix; specific timing-study evidence not supplied.
score_rationale.consistency: Annualization and wage products reconcile within rounding; unique respondents versus repeated QA contacts requires care.

item13.rationale: Only respondent time; no capital, O&M or services

item15.reason: Sample increase following declining response rates

assumptions: Private update frequency 3.2; state/local 3.6; QA recontacts approximately 5%.
FY2024/25/26 hours 39591, 41820, 42985; annualized over three years.

reconstruction_issues: Item 14 budget split cannot independently reconstruct federal resource quantities or allocations.
Item 15 does not quantify separate effects of sample size, response rates and cohort composition.
methods_worth_testing: Count time spent by nonrespondents and quality-assurance recontacts.
Use observed occupational mix and direct total compensation rather than an unexplained wage markup.
extraction_scope: Analytical model and key checks in this record; all DOCX table cells preserved separately. PDF tables remain in page-preserving text. Peripheral rows require normalization before final software reuse.
